  > The main text is over the NeurIPS 2026 limit (9 content pages including figures and tables; more is a desk rejection; references, appendix and checklist are outside, `venue.md` §Page limit).

  > ## Evidence
  > `document` branch, `dev/document.pdf` built from `3bc530abcd99` (and `main/document.pdf` built from `1a8b7399ce88`, the same): "6 Discussion and limitations" starts on p. 9 and runs onto **p. 10 (9 lines: the end of "Limitations", ll. 339–347)**; "References" starts on p. 10, line 348. The previous build (`34568977ca28`) fitted: main text ended on p. 9. The overrun came with the later text and the new tables (Tables 5/8 in the main body).
  > 
  > ## For
  > Cut or move to the appendix at least ~10 lines (more for slack, since a later edit can push it over again) so that the last main-text line is on p. 9 — without changing margins, font size or spacing (the style kit forbids it). Whoever reviews `release` should check the page of the last main-text line, not the total count.
